title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holds at $73,652, up 0.3 percent, while Fear & Greed crashes to 23 in extreme fear. Hashrate pushes 1,101 EH/s, showing miners stay committed even as sentiment collapses.

Overnight price action stayed tight with minimal Asia session movement. Mempool at 63k transactions keeps fees at 1 sat/vB, supporting steady on-chain flow.

Watch resistance at $74,000 and any macro headlines that could shift the fear gauge today.
